blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—FEU guard Jorick Bautista is fully aware of the chatter about the Tamaraws being one of the contenders in UAAP Season 89. The Tamaraws are starting to show with their recent surge, highlighted by back-to-back wins over title favorites, after dropping their season-opener against Adamson. They beat last year’s runner-up University of the Philippines on Sunday just four days after stunning defending champion La Salle.
